ready_for_owner.what: the visual confirmation that Paint shows the exported image
ready_for_owner.why: only a person can see what is on the screen
ready_for_owner.harness: look at the Paint window, or docs/evidence/m27-paint-lab-*.json

ready_for_owner.what: displays actually going dark, and one keypress waking them
ready_for_owner.why: only a person can see a blank screen and press a key; this script never darkens a display
ready_for_owner.harness: scripts\core\owner-m18-3-display.ps1 (arms the real receipt through POST /v1/ambient/test-display and warns first)

ready_for_owner.what: an alarm actually ringing, and the wake music
ready_for_owner.why: only a person can hear it; this script never issues desktop.alarm_start or desktop.play_audio
ready_for_owner.harness: scripts\core\owner-m18-3-alarm.ps1 -MusicUrl <your song> (creates a "test" alarm through Cloud Core and warns first)

ready_for_owner.what: desktop.play_audio on the real render endpoint
ready_for_owner.why: it needs a WAV served from the dialled broker origin with its sha256; level:0 is the silent lever if a later run wants it
